items.name: Session Zero
items.description: A first meeting to agree on expectations before the campaign starts.

items.name: Lines and Veils
items.description: Lines are topics left out entirely; veils are topics handled off-screen.

items.name: CATS (Content, Aim, Tone, Subject matter)
items.description: A short pitch format covering what the game contains and how it will feel.

items.name: Consent Checklist
items.description: A private checklist where each player marks topics they do or don't want.

items.name: X-Card
items.description: Anyone can tap the card to skip or change the current content, no explanation needed.

items.name: Script Change
items.description: Pause, rewind, fast-forward or frame-skip the scene like a film.

items.name: Open Door
items.description: Anyone may leave the table at any time without explaining.

items.name: Check-ins
items.description: The table pauses now and then to ask how everyone is doing.

items.name: Stars and Wishes
items.description: Each player names something that went well and something they'd like next time.

items.name: Roses and Thorns
items.description: Each player shares a highlight and a low point from the session.

items.name: Debrief
items.description: A short talk after play to decompress and raise concerns.
